title: Coal
standfirst: Coal leaves the pit for the power plant; its electricity grinds the cement, and the cement goes to the builders.

title: Cement
standfirst: Cement leaves the kiln for the builders, and the builders put up the estate the plants stand on.

title: From well to shelf
standfirst: Gas from the well becomes polymer, packaging, packed food, a distributor's load and a shelf; the packaging comes back through recovery as feedstock.
goods: liquid > bulk > boxed > boxed > boxed > bulk > bulk

title: Palm
standfirst: Crops leave the plantation for the food factory; the packed food goes through the distributor to the shelf.

title: Nickel
standfirst: Ore leaves the pit for the smelter and the metal leaves by ship; beside it the raw-export road carries ore out unprocessed.

title: The rupiah upstream
standfirst: A shopper's rupiah goes back up the chain: the shelf pays the distributor, the distributor the food factory, the factory the plantation, and the banks lend at each step.
